base.description: The brush panel as StarTech.com ships CMBRUSH1U.

datasheet.title: CMBRUSH1U data sheet: 1U High-density Brush Strip Cable Management Panel

description: 1U brush strip cable management panel, StarTech.com CMBRUSH1U: a black steel panel the full width of the rack with a window 382 mm long cut in it and a strip of high-density nylon bristles behind the window. Cables are pushed through the bristles from one side to the other, and the bristles close the opening so that air does not pass round them.

gaps.note: the datasheet and the drawing state no cable capacity, no fill and no cable count.
gaps.wanted: a cable capacity table, or a stated fill, for the brush panel

gaps.note: the A-A section draws the strip held in a clip on the top flange with a rounded head that reaches 20.2 mm, 3.0 beyond the 17.2 the panel is stated as, and three rivets along the top view; no view dimensions the clip or the head, so the strip is drawn as a thin band behind the plate and the panel's depth is the 17.2.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned section of the brush holder

gaps.note: the section draws the bristles leaning from the holder at the top to the bottom flange, a band about 37 mm long and 1.5 thick at its base (scaled at 9.4 px/mm); no dimension states them, so the band is estimated.
gaps.wanted: the bristles' length and the strip's thickness

body.description: the steel panel, its ears and its two folded flanges

name: cmbrush1u

attrs.note: datasheet - the material (steel, with nylon bristles; "Nylon 66" on the section), colour, standard (EIA RS310-D) and the screws (four 10/32 and four 12/24) are the datasheet's; the 2-year warranty is its text.

capacity.note: no document states a cable capacity: the datasheet and the drawing are silent, so none is stated and a gap says so.

chassis.note: drawing - 482.0 x 43.7 x 17.2. The plate is the whole width of the rack, its two ends the ears, so the face is drawn whole with its four slots (L43 stands down above 480 mm); its top and bottom edges fold back between the ears. The datasheet's "Length" is the 482.0 and its "Width" the 17.2 depth. The section's 20.2, which the datasheet calls "Internal Depth", is the depth across the section including the brush holder's head, 3 mm more than the 17.2 the maker states the product as; 17.2 is drawn and the head is a gap.

color.note: estimated - "Color: Black". The drawing is line work, so the shade is this library's render of black steel; the bristles are the library's brush pattern.

ears.note: drawing - `positions` states where the ears bolt, for the Rack Builder. The ears are the flat ends of the plate, which is the front of the panel, and its flanges fold back behind it (the section: the plate on one side, the flanges and the brush's holder on the other). The datasheet says "Front Mount (Front Only)". So the plate is flush with the rail and `at` is 0. This states a placement; no dimension changed.

front.note: drawing - the front view: the plate with its four slots in a 465.0 by 31.7 rectangle and the brush window, 382.0 long and 23.3 high, with the bristles seen through it. The window is 12.4 from the top edge and 8.0 from the bottom.

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - the panel reaches 17.2 mm behind the rail, so the rear face of its rack unit stays free for another part.

left.note: drawing - the A-A section as an elevation: the plate in front, the two flanges folded back from it and the brush strip behind the plate. The right is the same, turned round.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S OWN DRAWING. StarTech.com publishes CMBRUSH1U_Diagram.pdf (third angle projection, millimetres, REV A, 06/02/2020): a top view, a front view, a side view with its A-A section and an isometric of the panel and its brush, with the dimensions 482.0, 465.0, 435.0, 382.0, 17.2, 23.3, 8.0, 6.0, 31.7, 20.2, 43.7, "4-#7.0x10.0" and "t=1.2mm". The datasheet (cmbrush1u_datasheet.pdf) lists "Product Length 19.0 in [48.2 cm]", "Product Width 0.7 in [17.2 mm]", "Product Height 1.7 in [43.7 mm]" and "Internal Depth 0.8 in [20.2 mm]". The window's place and the flanges' extents are scaled off the views at 0.78 to 2.34 px/mm against their own dimensions, and are estimated.

passes.note: drawing - the window is the pass-through: a cable crosses it through the bristles, so it is declared `brush` over the window's 382.0 by 23.3. The datasheet says the strip "offers cable separation" and "closes off open spaces between equipment".

rear.note: estimated - the back of the plate: the bristles in their window, the slots and the folded edges end-on. The drawing has no rear view; this is the front view seen from behind, with the strip behind the window.

thickness.note: drawing - 1.2 mm, "Panel spcc/hc, t=1.2mm" on the A-A section.

top.note: drawing - an elevation, rear at the top: the flange 17.2 deep behind the plate, between the ears. The drawing's top view shows three rivets along it, at which the brush holder is fixed; they are not drawn. The bottom is the same from underneath, the bottom flange shorter (14.4, estimated off the section).
